## Findings
<a id="findings"></a>

- <a id="research.frontend-src-app.415ff023"></a>**1. The unit frontend/src/app consists of three source files: frontend/src/app/globals.css, frontend/src/app/layout.tsx, and frontend/src/app/page.tsx.**
  [`globals.css:1-137`](../globals.css#L1-L137)
  [`layout.tsx:1-40`](../layout.tsx#L1-L40)
  [`page.tsx:1-78`](../page.tsx#L1-L78)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-app.300cc84c"></a>**2. frontend/src/app/layout.tsx exports a default RootLayout component that renders an <html> element with lang 'en' and data-theme 'schedule-light', and a <body> that applies the geistSans and geistMono CSS variables with the classes 'antialiased min-h-screen bg-base-100 flex flex-col', wrapping the children in the LayoutContent component.**
  [`layout.tsx:24-39`](../layout.tsx#L24-L39)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-app.04e4ad6e"></a>**3. frontend/src/app/page.tsx exports a default Home component that renders a hero section headed by the title 'Tuks Schedule Generator', a description of transforming a Tuks PDF schedule into calendar events, and a 'Get Started' Link to '/upload' containing a primary Button.**
  [`page.tsx:6-28`](../page.tsx#L6-L28)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-app.3f5ad31d"></a>**4. frontend/src/app/layout.tsx imports the Metadata type from 'next', the Geist and Geist_Mono fonts from 'next/font/google', the global stylesheet './globals.css', and the LayoutContent component from '@/components/layout/LayoutContent'.**
  [`layout.tsx:1-4`](../layout.tsx#L1-L4)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-app.3fed86c7"></a>**5. frontend/src/app/page.tsx imports Link from 'next/link' and the Button component from '@/components/common'.**
  [`page.tsx:3-4`](../page.tsx#L3-L4)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-app.0e104ca6"></a>**6. frontend/src/app/layout.tsx exports a metadata object declaring the page title 'Tuks Schedule Generator', the description 'Convert your Tuks PDF schedule to calendar events', and the icon '/favicon.png'.**
  [`layout.tsx:16-22`](../layout.tsx#L16-L22)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-app.ff2ac21d"></a>**7. frontend/src/app/layout.tsx defines a geistSans constant that instantiates the Geist font with the CSS variable '--font-geist-sans' and the latin subset.**
  [`layout.tsx:6-9`](../layout.tsx#L6-L9)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-app.856b96aa"></a>**8. frontend/src/app/layout.tsx defines a geistMono constant that instantiates the Geist_Mono font with the CSS variable '--font-geist-mono' and the latin subset.**
  [`layout.tsx:11-14`](../layout.tsx#L11-L14)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-app.4cbacf2a"></a>**9. frontend/src/app/page.tsx begins with the 'use client' directive, marking the module as a client component.**
  [`page.tsx:1-1`](../page.tsx#L1-L1)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-app.c3887a51"></a>**10. The Home component renders a 'How It Works' section with three feature cards titled 'Upload PDF', 'Preview Events', and 'Export Calendar', describing the upload, preview, and export steps of the service.**
  [`page.tsx:30-74`](../page.tsx#L30-L74)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-app.fc596589"></a>**11. frontend/src/app/globals.css imports Tailwind CSS and registers the daisyUI plugin.**
  [`globals.css:1-2`](../globals.css#L1-L2)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-app.d210f15b"></a>**12. frontend/src/app/globals.css defines a 'schedule-light' daisyUI theme, set as the default with a light color scheme, using oklch color variables with an electric blue accent.**
  [`globals.css:4-39`](../globals.css#L4-L39)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-app.9ceebbfe"></a>**13. frontend/src/app/globals.css defines a 'schedule-dark' daisyUI theme, set to prefer dark mode with a dark color scheme, using deep black backgrounds with an electric blue accent.**
  [`globals.css:41-76`](../globals.css#L41-L76)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-app.1c965720"></a>**14. frontend/src/app/globals.css sets the body font-family to Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif.**
  [`globals.css:78-80`](../globals.css#L78-L80)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-app.c1fc1b65"></a>**15. frontend/src/app/globals.css styles a .google-signin-btn class for light mode with a white background, pill shape, and hover, active, focus, and disabled states.**
  [`globals.css:82-116`](../globals.css#L82-L116)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-app.665ac2f9"></a>**16. frontend/src/app/globals.css provides dark-mode overrides for the .google-signin-btn class under the [data-theme='schedule-dark'] selector.**
